text:
sre-alex: Heads up — seeing controller-manager leader in eu-west1 lose its lease repeatedly over the last 3m. GPU autoscaler stalled: many GPU pods Pending and provisioning not progressing. Logs show lease renew RPC failures (connection reset). Anyone else seeing network blips?

oncall-bot: incident-detect: controller-manager leader transitions high (12 in last 5m). Generated alert: CP-LEADER-CHURN-EUW.

infra-maria: Confirming — our nat-gateway health checks hit a spike. VPC alert fired ~12:13 UTC. I'm failing over to standby NAT now, will update in a minute.

kevin: Can we scale down gpu-provisioner replicas to 1 while we stabilize? It's hammering the API during leader churn and creating a backlog.

sre-alex: Pasted relevant logs: 
```
E0312 12:14:02.345 controller-manager lease.go:123] RenewLease error: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
W0312 12:14:02.346 leader_election.go:210] Failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
apiserver proxy: 503: upstream connection reset
```

infra-maria: NAT failover applied at 12:15 UTC — standby took traffic, packet loss dropped back to baseline. I'm seeing leader election stabilize (fewer transitions).

deploy-bot: action: restarted controller-manager replica eu-west1-az-a (manual) — success.

kevin: After the restart and NAT failover, leader election settled. GPU provisioning backlog is clearing now; ~80% of Pending pods transitioned to Running over the last 10m. We'll keep an eye on evictions.

sre-alex: Quick postmortem notes / immediate actions: 1) add circuit-breaker to gpu-provisioner so it backs off on leader churn, 2) add nat-gateway packet-loss p95 alert to SRE dashboards, 3) run a staging chaos test to simulate NAT failover and measure controller-manager resilience. I'll file the tickets.

infra-maria: Filed infra/1254: "NAT standby failover verification and alerting" and assigned to myself. Will also check BGP/session metrics and route propagation timing for eu-west.

kevin: Cost heads-up — some GPU allocations were created and then evicted during churn, expect a small provisioning cost bump for this hour. Monitoring billing alert.

sre-alex: Thanks all. Closing thread for now — reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
